negoScenarios.desc: The merchant looks you over, arms crossed. "These prices are standard. Everyone pays the same here."

choices.label: "I'm looking for a long-term relationship — that's worth mutual effort."
"I just want to know if you have any margin."
"That's too expensive. Change your prices or I'm leaving."

negoScenarios.desc: He hesitates. "I have other buyers interested in exactly the same thing."

choices.label: "My contacts will talk about this deal. Your reputation benefits too."
"Then decide quickly — I have other options too."
"You're bluffing. Nobody else will pay that price."

negoScenarios.desc: He looks you straight in the eyes. "Give me one good reason to cut you a deal."

choices.label: "Cash, right now, no paperwork or checks. Clean and fast."
"Because we both win, right?"
"Because you need to sell and I'm here."

navScenarios.desc: An asteroid field blocks the direct route. The debris drifts slowly — but some pieces are fast.

choices.label: Throttle down and navigate with precision
Go around through the north sector (longer route)
Full throttle and push through

navScenarios.desc: An abandoned ship drifts across your path. Its emergency systems are still blinking.

choices.label: Adjust course, gently steer clear
Send a recon signal before diverting
Hold course — the ship will pass

navScenarios.desc: An unidentified signal has been following you for several minutes. Irregular frequency — probably a hunter.

choices.label: Cut emissions and hide in nearby debris
Send a standard ID and continue
Ignore it and maintain speed

navScenarios.desc: A solar particle storm approaches. Sensors indicate a 90-second window.

choices.label: Raise forward shields and slow down
Turn to starboard — longer but safer route
Accelerate to outrun the front

navScenarios.desc: A military patrol is scanning the sector. Your cargo could draw attention.

choices.label: Cut thrusters and drift slowly out of the scan cone
Respond normally to their hail and hope for the best
Accelerate to clear the scan zone

navScenarios.desc: A debris tunnel from an old battle crosses your path. Twisted metal, floating plates.

choices.label: Pass slowly, shields up, full attention
Go around — costs 20 extra minutes
Push through fast — less time in the danger zone

timeoutNav: Too slow — the ship takes the hit.
timeoutNego: Time's up — you hesitated too long. He loses patience.

navMsgs.neutral: Alternate path — acceptable outcome. -5 ship HP.
navMsgs.bad: Impact. The ship shudders. -13 ship HP.

navFooter: 3 good maneuvers = +500 cr · 2 good = +200 cr · otherwise nothing
